title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11291)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This code of practice is designed to assist organizations to develop and document general test strategies, test plans and procedures that will give confidence that the design and implementation of their computerbased systems will be of adequate quality for the purpose the systems are to fulfil.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
